tools.name: get_whale_trades
tools.description: Polymarket whale trades: the largest recent buys and sells across all markets above a size you choose, with trader name, outcome, price and USD size. 5- and 15-minute crypto markets filtered out. Pair with /v1/wallet to check whether a whale is any good.

tools.name: get_wallet_scorecard
tools.description: Polymarket trader scorecard for any wallet: skill score (0-100), edge over the odds paid, win rate vs. the win rate the odds implied, return (ROI), realized PnL, specialty and largest open positions. Scores the latest 200 finished bets, losses included.

tools.name: list_top_traders

tools.name: get_smart_money

tools.name: get_skilled_whale_trades
tools.description: Smart-money whale trades on Polymarket: recent large trades by skilled (Solid or Sharp) traders only, each tagged with the trader's skill score, edge over the odds paid, return and specialty. Separates informed whales from big gamblers.

tools.name: find_market_disagreements
tools.description: Polymarket markets where smart money disagrees with the odds: scans the 30 busiest open markets every 15 minutes and returns those where skilled traders' money implies a different probability than the price, tempered against thin evidence, with a low, medium or high confidence rating. Data, not inve

tools.name: get_drug_safety

tools.name: detect_drug_safety_signals

tools.name: get_drug_label

tools.name: list_drug_approvals

tools.name: get_app_ratings
tools.description: App-store ratings for public companies' apps: for a ticker, each app's star rating and number of ratings with a ratings-weighted average; without a ticker, the most-rated and lowest-rated apps across public companies. A customer-satisfaction signal. Data, not investment advice.

tools.description: Stock trades by members of Congress (House and Senate STOCK Act disclosures): member, party, chamber, buy or sell, reported amount range, trade and disclosure dates, late-disclosure flag, and how the stock has moved since the trade versus the S&P 500. tools.name: get_congress_member
tools.description: Profile of one member of Congress: party, chamber, state, estimated net worth, total trades and volume, their recent stock trades (with options details and the price move since each trade), most-traded stocks and the holdings they report. tools.name: list_congress_holdings
tools.description: Stocks members of Congress report owning in their annual financial disclosures: for a ticker, which members hold it and the reported values; without a ticker, the stocks held by the most members. Facts, not investment advice.

tools.name: list_revolving_door_lobbyists

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_drug_approvals, list_insider_feed, list_corporate_lobbying · Private data: get_whale_trades, get_wallet_scorecard, get_airport_status, list_flight_disruptions · Public sink: get_drug_safety, get_off_exchange_volume, list_top_shareholders, get_executive_pay.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_drug_approvals, list_insider_feed, list_corporate_lobbying · Private data: get_whale_trades, get_wallet_scorecard, get_airport_status, list_flight_disruptions · Public sink: get_drug_safety, get_off_exchange_volume, list_top_shareholders, get_executive_pay

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
